title: A real World Editor
text:
The World Editor has been rebuilt from the ground up: menus, panels, new painting tools, copy and paste, a problem checker and one-click publishing.

✨ Rebuilt World Editor (/play/editor.html) with a menu bar, a tool bar, a tool options bar, side panels (Palette, Inspector, Objects, Layers, Problems, History), a minimap and a status bar
✨ New painting tools: brush with round or square tips, straight lines, filled or outlined rectangles, flood fill and an eyedropper. Every tool paints ground or zones
✨ Box select, multi-select, move, Alt-drag to copy, duplicate, nudge with the arrow keys, and copy and paste of objects together with the ground underneath
✨ Scatter props with random rotation and size, snap to half tiles, and edit everything in the Inspector: position, rotation, size, names, titles, colours and dialogue
✨ Problems panel: lists anything the game would skip, such as two NPCs with the same name, monsters on blocked ground or unnamed landmarks, and jumps to it
✨ Find (Ctrl+F) any NPC, landmark, zone or monster, a command palette (Ctrl+K), a right-click menu, a history you can jump through, saved versions and keyboard shortcuts for everything
✨ Publish your world to the realm straight from the editor with your owner password, and optionally save it to GitHub so it stays after restarts
⬆️ Preview in game now starts you where the editor's map was centred
